About

Data work that people can act on

I’m Mahmoud, a data analyst who turns raw, scattered data into dashboards and pipelines that teams actually rely on. Over 3+ years I’ve built Power BI reporting and Azure ETL workflows that cut manual reporting by 40%.

I care about the whole chain: clean, well-modeled data underneath, clear KPIs on top, and automation in between so the numbers are always fresh. When a question goes beyond reporting, I bring in Python and machine learning for forecasting and prediction.
